name: statistical_analysis

knowledge_assets.title: Assumptions and diagnostics
knowledge_assets.purpose: Check distributional, variance, independence, and model diagnostics before interpreting inferential results.

knowledge_assets.title: Bayesian statistics
knowledge_assets.purpose: Route analyses toward Bayesian estimands, priors, posterior summaries, and diagnostics when a Bayesian alternative is appropriate.

knowledge_assets.title: Effect sizes and power
knowledge_assets.purpose: Connect effect-size reporting, uncertainty, and sensitivity analysis to the selected statistical model.

knowledge_assets.title: Statistical reporting standards
knowledge_assets.purpose: Produce reproducible reporting with exact statistics, effect sizes, intervals, multiplicity handling, and limitations.

knowledge_assets.title: Test selection guide
knowledge_assets.purpose: Map outcome type, group structure, dependence, and design to defensible tests or models.

description: Statistical analysis is a cross-domain analysis primitive for test selection, assumption checking, effect sizes, power sensitivity, Bayesian alternatives, and research reporting. Use it when comparing groups, testing hypotheses, analyzing experiments or surveys, checking diagnostics, or writing statistical results.
capabilities: Select statistical tests from design, outcome, predictor, and dependency structure.
Require assumption checks and remedial alternatives before interpretation.
Report effect sizes, intervals, and exact test statistics.
Route low-level model implementation to statsmodels, scipy, pingouin, pymc, or domain executors.
requirements: A clear outcome, predictor/group structure, study design, and unit of analysis.
Raw or cleaned analysis table with missingness and exclusions documented.
Appropriate statistical package or executor when real computation is required.
